title: Standard Ethernet and Its Evolution
markdown:
## Standard Ethernet

The original Ethernet was created in 1976 at Xerox's Palo Alto Research
Center (PARC). Since then it has gone through four generations. This
section briefly discusses the Standard (traditional) Ethernet.

A root node "Ethernet evolution" branches into four generations, each
shown as a pink box with its data rate captioned below in magenta:

{{viz:0}}

| Generation | Data Rate |
|---|---|
| Standard Ethernet | 10 Mbps |
| Fast Ethernet | 100 Mbps |
| Gigabit Ethernet | 1 Gbps |
| Ten-Gigabit Ethernet | 10 Gbps |
